about.en: IQ is the governance and utility token of the IQ ecosystem built by Brainfund, originally created for the Everipedia (now IQ.wiki) blockchain encyclopedia and since extended to IQ AI's agent tokenization platform and the ADK-TS agent framework. It launched on EOS and is now primarily an ERC-20 token on Ethereum (contract 0x579cea1889991f68acc35ff5c3dd0621ff29b0c9), bridged to Polygon, Arbitrum and other chains.
